player_prompt.intro:
Yu pilai Mastermind.
Yu mas kisim kod i longpela {code_length} digit, kila digit nambari longpela 1 go {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Long yu respon, yu ken subim yu gess long format hia: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Bihaen kila gess, yu bai kisim feedbek long fom blak na wait peg.
Wanpela blak peg i soim nambari i stret long ples stret, wail wanpela wait peg i soim nambari i stret tasol long ples rong.
Yu gat {max_turns} raun long gessim kod.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: i no gat ol narapela tok bilong en

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yu no bin bekim long wanpela lista i gat ol namba em yu putim insait long braiket.
invalid_move.not_integers: Olgeta tok i mas stap olsem ol namba tru.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Dispela tok i mas gat namba {code_length} stret.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Olgeta namba i mas stap namel long 1 na {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Ol i no ken yusim namba bilong narapela nem.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Yu ting {guess} em i wanpela bilong ol dispela namba. Plis traim narapela toksave.

game_action.feedback: Yu subim [{guess}]. Feedbek: {black_pegs} blak peg, {white_pegs} wait peg.

outcome.win: Yu kamap winim kod, solvim {black_pegs} long {code_length} pegs korrek
outcome.turn_limit: Yu inapim pinis mak bilong tanim. {percent} % long ol namba yu bin ting i stret.
